ACADEMIC: 49

HR: 63
(i) Suggest the most suitable block to house the server, with a reason.

(iv) A switch (an intelligent device that sends data only to the intended computer).
(v) FTP (File Transfer Protocol).

items.stem:
Sanjeevani Care Centre is setting up its campus in Pune with four blocks: HR, LOGISTICS, LIBRARY, DESIGN. Its head office is in Varanasi, about 1800 km away.
Distances between the blocks:
HR to LOGISTICS: 65 m
HR to LIBRARY: 30 m
HR to DESIGN: 280 m
LOGISTICS to LIBRARY: 250 m
LOGISTICS to DESIGN: 115 m
LIBRARY to DESIGN: 110 m
Number of computers in each block:
HR: 57
LOGISTICS: 119
LIBRARY: 26
DESIGN: 63
(i) Suggest the most suitable block to house the server, with a reason.
(ii) Suggest a cable layout (block to block) for connecting the blocks efficiently.
(iii) Between which blocks should a repeater be placed, if the layout in (ii) is used and Ethernet cable is used for connections?
(iv) Which device should be used to connect all the computers within each block?
(v) The company wants to prevent unauthorised access to its network from the Internet. What should be installed?
items.answer:
(i) LOGISTICS, because it has the maximum number of computers (119); most traffic stays within the block (80:20 rule).
(ii) Star layout with LOGISTICS at the centre: LOGISTICS–HR, LOGISTICS–LIBRARY, LOGISTICS–DESIGN.
(iii) Between LOGISTICS and LIBRARY (250 m), LOGISTICS and DESIGN (115 m), as the distance is more than 100 m.
(iv) A switch (an intelligent device that sends data only to the intended computer).
(v) A firewall (hardware or software) at the point where the campus connects to the Internet.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each part (i)–(v); in (ii) any efficient layout centred on the server block earns the mark.
